text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible performance from
Silence
Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Arrgh! I was this close to passing her!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I'm having a little trouble
concentrating.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: ...If you're okay with me, I'm all ears.
...If you're okay with me, I'm here to listen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the concern. I'll be okay on
my own,
though.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I run in it now, I feel like I might not
be able to
give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So... Can I take some time to consider
whether I
want to enter or not?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: ...If you say so, let's do that.
...If you say so, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, it's no good not to have a
goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As far as Classic races go, she may still
be able to
run in the Kikuka Sho in the
autumn if we set our
sights on
September's Kobe Shimbun Hai in

preparation.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I'll be able to perform so
well...
choice_data_list: How about the Kobe Shimbun Hai?
How about the Kobe Shimbun Hai?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: It's better than getting nothing out of the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend the next few days wondering
what I can
do for her.
